en.name: Nagini
en.ability: You are a Horcrux. Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day. If you choose Neville this way, Neville learns this.

revisions.v1: You are a Horcrux. Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day. If you choose Neville this way, Neville learns this.

en.flavor: You know Voldemort's snake, Neville? He's got a huge snake... Calls it Nagini... It's got to be killed.
en.otherNightReminder: Choose who to poison. Potentially inform Neville he was chosen by Nagini (He is still poisoned)
